statement: When the Binance USD-M perp mid moves >= theta bp within 2 s and Lighter's mid has not yet followed (< theta/2 in the same direction), a Lighter Standard-account taker order in the Binance direction, arriving after our latency plus Lighter's 300 ms taker speed bump and held H seconds, is profitable after crossing the recorded spread (0 fee).

data.recorder: scripts/research/memelag_recorder.py -> data/raw/web/memelag/<table>_<YYYY-MM-DD-HH>.parquet, tables binance_bbo, lighter_bbo, lighter_trades, hl_bbo (hour = UTC hour of ts_us). Same compaction as multivenue (price changes coalesced at 50 ms, size-only changes at 500 ms).
data.leader: binance bbo (fstream <sym>@bookTicker), clock = local receive time ts_us
data.follower: lighter bbo (ticker/<market_id> channel, readonly WS), clock = local receive time ts_us; lighter trades recorded for diagnostics only
data.clock_rule: All decisions and fills use our local receive timestamps ts_us (microseconds, same container clock for every venue). Venue timestamps (exch_ts_ms) are NEVER mixed with local timestamps in scoring (lesson of reports/paper/hllag_forward_audit.md: the container clock is ~2.8 s slow and drifts, so local-vs-exchange comparisons are biased). A venue state 'at time t' is the last recorded row with ts_us <= t. Lighter trades are recorded for diagnostics only. Hyperliquid bbo is recorded for later use and is NOT part of this hypothesis.

split.T0: launch time of the 48-h memelag recorder run: the 'start' line (start_ts_us) in data/raw/web/memelag/recorder.log. Rows before T0 (test runs, which go to the scratchpad, not this directory) are never scored.
split.day1_train: [T0, T0+24h): exploratory; all 12 configs are run and ONE is selected by the selection rule
split.day2_validation: [T0+24h, T0+48h): the selected config only, run ONCE
split.forward: after day 2, freeze the selected config (scoring-module sha256 + params + frozen_at) and score only data received after the freeze time (needs a later recorder run; until then the forward record is empty)
split.early_stop: If the recorder stops before T0+48h (disk guard, crash), day 2 is whatever was recorded in [T0+24h, stop) and this is reported; if < 12 h of day 2 exist, the validation is INCONCLUSIVE, not re-run on later data with re-selection.

data.gaps: Minutes where either venue has no bbo row for > 10 s (feed gap or reconnect) are excluded for that coin: no trigger may be taken in a gap, and a position whose entry or exit falls in a gap is closed at the first state after the gap and flagged.

rule.trigger: At each binance bbo row (decision time t = its ts_us) compute r_B = mid_B(t)/mid_B(t-2s) - 1 (mid_B(t-2s) = last state at or before t-2 s). Trigger if |r_B| >= theta. Direction d = sign(r_B).
rule.follower_filter: r_L = mid_L(t)/mid_L(t-2s) - 1 on Lighter; require d*r_L < theta/2.
rule.entry: Taker in direction d on Lighter. Fill time t_in = t + L_total. Buy fills at the last recorded Lighter best ask at t_in (sell at best bid).
rule.exit: Exit decision at t_in + H; exit fill time t_out = t_in + H + L_total, at the last recorded Lighter opposite best at t_out.
rule.position_rules: one position per coin; cooldown 10 s per coin after exit fill before a new trigger; no stop, no gap-close exit (HLLAG showed gap-close exits cut the gross).
rule.size: target $1,000 notional. Entry size = min($1,000, displayed opposite top-of-book notional at t_in). If the displayed top notional is < $100 the trigger is SKIPPED and counted as a skip. Exit: size up to the displayed opposite top at t_out fills at that price; any excess fills one full spread (ask-bid at t_out) worse.
rule.fees: Lighter Standard account: 0 maker / 0 taker (DOC, see plan). Spread is paid by the fill model; no zero-impact fills. Hourly Lighter orderBooks fee snapshot in data/raw/web/memelag/meta_lighter.jsonl; all 11 markets 0/0 at the 2026-10-05 check.
rule.funding: ignored (holds <= 32 s; Lighter funding is hourly)
rule.pnl_unit: USD per round trip; bp = USD / notional * 1e4

grid.latency_note: L_total = our order path (~300 ms assumed, unmeasured) + Lighter Standard taker speed bump 300 ms (DOC) = 600 ms; 900 ms is the pessimistic case (+300 ms for our real path / Lighter-to-us feed delay).

selection_rule_day1: Among configs with n >= 30 round trips on day 1, select the one with the highest profit factor (ties: larger n). If no config has net USD > 0 and PF > 1.0 on day 1, H-LIGHTLAG is KILLED and day 2 is not run for it. The selected config must also show net USD > 0 with +0.5 bp extra cost per round trip; if it does not, the next-best config by the same rule that does is taken.
kill_test_day1: Pre-registered in the leads file: for theta=25 triggers on day 1 (no position rules), mean d * (Lighter mid(t+30 s)/Lighter mid(t+600 ms) - 1) in bp. If < 3 bp, H-LIGHTLAG is KILLED regardless of the grid.
validation_day2: Run the selected config once on day 2. Bar: n >= 50 round trips, net USD > 0, PF > 1.2, net without the top-3 trades > 0. If n < 50 the result is INCONCLUSIVE (not a pass); the config is frozen anyway and the forward record continues until n >= 50; no re-selection.
reporting: Report all 12 day-1 configs (n, net, mean bp, PF, skips), the kill test, and the day-2 result, including losses. No Aster control (not recorded for these coins). Results also reported by coin.
no_changes: No change to grid, trigger, fill model, fees, universe, split or selection rule after this file is written. A change requires a new hypothesis id with a rationale (parent + failing run).
